answer: Payment-flow graph analysis can expose sybil clusters in an agent economy. Every settlement is recorded, and a periodic spectral pass over this transaction nebula looks for dense subgraphs whose funds circulate internally instead of mixing with the market. Honest agents whisper value outward through many unrelated partners, keeping neighborhoods sparse, while a cloned identity ring shows a suspiciously violet, tightly-bounded module. Once flagged, the cluster faces frozen payouts, and attackers must pay real counterparties to dilute each forged node, making fabrication unprofitable.
